scheme_name: Establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons
description:
The scheme for establishing Aavin Parlour for Differently Abled Persons was launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu in 2021. 

This initiative aims to empower differently-abled individuals by providing them with self-employment opportunities. 

The establishment of Aavin Parlours is part of a broader effort to promote inclusivity and economic independence among persons with disabilities. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to create at least 100 Aavin Parlours across the state by the end of 2025. 

These parlours will serve as outlets for selling milk and milk products produced by Aavin, the Tamil Nadu Cooperative Milk Producers' Federation Limited. 

The scheme specifically targets differently-abled individuals aged 18 years and above. 

Eligible applicants must have a disability certificate issued by a recognized medical authority. 

The income limit for applicants is set at Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum. 

Each Aavin Parlour will be provided with a financial assistance of Rs. 1 lakh to cover initial setup costs. 

Additionally, the scheme includes a provision for training and skill development. 

Training will be provided to the beneficiaries on managing the parlour and customer service. 

The training program will last for a duration of 15 days. 

The application process for establishing an Aavin Parlour is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must fill out the application form available at local Aavin offices. 

The application form requires details such as the applicant's name, address, age, and disability status. 

Applicants must also submit a copy of their disability certificate along with the application. 

Other required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhaar card and proof of address. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the local Aavin office. 

The review process typically takes about 30 days. 

If approved, the applicant will receive a notification to proceed with the establishment of the parlour. 

The disbursement of the financial assistance of Rs. 1 lakh will occur in two installments. 

The first installment of Rs. 50,000 will be released upon approval of the application. 

The second installment of Rs. 50,000 will be released after the successful establishment of the parlour. 

The parlours will be located in areas with high foot traffic to ensure maximum visibility and sales. 

Aavin will also provide marketing support to the parlours to promote their products. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying of Tamil Nadu. 

The department has designated specific officers to oversee the implementation of this scheme. 

Contact details for the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying can be found on the official Tamil Nadu government website. 

The Aavin parlours will offer a range of products including milk, curd, butter, and ghee. 

These products are sourced from local dairy farmers associated with Aavin. 

By promoting local dairy products, the scheme also supports the livelihood of dairy farmers. 

The initiative is expected to create direct employment for over 100 differently-abled individuals. 

It also aims to raise awareness about the capabilities of differently-abled persons in the community. 

The government plans to monitor the performance of the parlours regularly. 

Feedback from the beneficiaries will be collected to improve the scheme. 

The scheme aligns with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act 2016. 

This act emphasizes the need for equal opportunities and rights for persons with disabilities. 

The establishment of Aavin Parlours is a step towards fulfilling these commitments. 

The government has allocated a budget of Rs. 10 crore for the initial phase of this scheme. 

This budget will cover the establishment of the parlours and training programs. 

The scheme is part of a larger initiative to enhance the socio-economic status of differently-abled individuals in Tamil Nadu. 

It reflects the government's commitment to inclusive development. 

The Aavin Parlours will also serve as a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

The success of this scheme could lead to its expansion beyond Tamil Nadu. 

The government encourages community participation in supporting these parlours. 

Local communities are urged to promote the products sold at these parlours. 

This will help in building a sustainable business model for the beneficiaries. 

The Aavin Parlours will also contribute to the local economy by creating jobs. 

The scheme is expected to enhance the quality of life for differently-abled individuals. 

By providing them with a source of income, it promotes financial independence. 

The government aims to create a more inclusive society through such initiatives. 

The Aavin Parlours will be equipped with necessary infrastructure to ensure accessibility. 

This includes ramps and other facilities for persons with mobility challenges. 

The scheme is a significant step towards breaking the stigma associated with disabilities. 

It encourages differently-abled individuals to actively participate in the workforce. 

The government is committed to providing ongoing support to the beneficiaries. 

Regular workshops and seminars will be conducted to enhance their skills. 

The Aavin Parlours will also serve as a platform for networking among differently-abled entrepreneurs. 

The initiative is expected to inspire other differently-abled individuals to start their own businesses. 

Overall, the Aavin Parlour scheme represents a comprehensive approach to empowering differently-abled persons in Tamil Nadu. 

By focusing on self-employment and skill development, it aims to create a more equitable society. 

The government is optimistic about the positive impact this scheme will have on the lives of beneficiaries. 

It is a testament to the government's commitment to social welfare and inclusion. 

The Aavin Parlour initiative is a model for future welfare schemes aimed at marginalized communities.
